meta.desc.zh: Sycamore Agritech Limited 总部位于马拉维利隆圭，规模化种植灌溉小麦和制种玉米，并提供拖拉机、圆盘犁、深松机、精量播种机、喷杆喷雾机、联合收割机等农业机械租赁服务。
meta.desc.en: Sycamore Agritech Limited, based in Lilongwe, Malawi, grows irrigated wheat and seed maize at scale and offers agricultural machinery hire: tractors, disc ploughs, subsoilers, precision planters, boom sprayers, a combine harvester and more.

hero.lead.zh: Sycamore Agritech 在马拉维经营规模化农场，用中心支轴式喷灌种植小麦，并按种子生产要求种植制种玉米。我们拥有成套现代农业机械，除了服务自己的农场，也对外提供农机租赁。
hero.lead.en: Sycamore Agritech runs large-scale farms in Malawi, growing wheat under centre-pivot irrigation and maize for seed production. We own a full fleet of modern farm machinery, which works on our own fields and is also available for hire.

hero.tag.seed.note: maize grown to produce seed (hybrid seed production), NOT grain/commercial maize

biz.farming.text.zh: 灌溉小麦与制种玉米，从整地到收储全程自主管理。
biz.farming.text.en: Irrigated wheat and seed maize, managed in-house from land preparation to storage.

biz.hire.text.zh: 拖拉机及整地、播种、植保、收获、灌溉机械，可安排机手作业。
biz.hire.text.en: Tractors and machinery for land preparation, planting, spraying, harvesting and irrigation, with operators available.

biz.supply.text.zh: 为面粉厂、种子企业等客户稳定供应自产小麦和制种玉米。
biz.supply.text.en: A steady supply of our own wheat and seed maize for flour mills, seed companies and other businesses.

farming.h2.zh: 我们的核心：规模化种植
farming.h2.en: At our core: farming at scale

farming.p1.zh: 种植是 Sycamore Agritech 的核心业务。我们在马拉维的农场主要种植两种作物：在凉爽旱季依靠灌溉种植的小麦，以及按种子生产要求管理的制种玉米。农田大面积连片，配套中心支轴式喷灌和卷盘式喷灌机，按作物生长阶段供水。
farming.p1.en: Farming is the heart of Sycamore Agritech. Our farms in Malawi grow two main crops: wheat, grown under irrigation through the cool dry season, and maize grown for seed production. Our fields are large and contiguous, served by centre-pivot and hose-reel irrigation that waters each crop according to its growth stage.

farming.p2.zh: 我们的团队全程管理田间作业：整地、播种、灌溉、施肥、植保到适时收获，依靠自有的成套机械完成，让每一季的产量和品质都有保障。
farming.p2.en: Our team runs the whole field cycle with our own fleet of machinery, from land preparation and planting to irrigation, fertilisation, crop protection and timely harvest, protecting both yield and quality every season.

practice.pivot.text.zh: 大型喷灌机绕中心旋转，均匀覆盖整片农田，节水省工。
practice.pivot.text.en: Large pivots rotate around a central point, watering whole fields evenly while saving water and labour.

practice.care.text.zh: 按生长阶段安排施肥与植保，定期巡田，及早发现并处理问题。
practice.care.text.en: Fertiliser and crop protection timed to each growth stage, with regular field scouting to catch problems early.

practice.mech.text.zh: 从深松、犁地、精量播种到喷药和收获，主要环节都由我们自有的机械完成。
practice.mech.text.en: From ripping and ploughing to precision planting, spraying and harvesting, the key operations are done with our own machinery.

practice.store.text.zh: 成熟后及时收获，清理、装袋后入库保存，保持干燥洁净。
practice.store.text.en: Crops are harvested at maturity, then cleaned, bagged and stored to keep them dry and clean.

farming.caption.zh: 清晨的小麦田，远处是中心支轴式喷灌机
farming.caption.en: Wheat at first light, with a centre pivot on the horizon

season.text.zh: 马拉维一年有两个主要种植季：雨季种植以玉米为主的雨养作物，凉爽旱季则依靠灌溉种植小麦等冬季作物。整地要赶在播种之前完成，这也是农机最紧张的时候。
season.text.en: Malawi has two main cropping seasons: rain-fed crops, mainly maize, in the rainy season, and irrigated winter crops such as wheat in the cool dry season. Land has to be prepared before planting, which is when machinery is in highest demand.

season.note.zh: 按马拉维一般农时整理，各地区、各年份会有差异。资料来源：FEWS NET、FAO GIEWS、马拉维气候变化与气象局。
season.note.en: A general guide to Malawi's seasons; timing varies by region and year. Sources: FEWS NET, FAO GIEWS, Malawi Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services.
season.note.note: keep organisation names; translate the Malawian department name naturally or keep it in English

irri.intro.zh: 马拉维的降雨集中在雨季，旱季种植离不开灌溉。我们的农田配备两类喷灌设备。
irri.intro.en: Malawi's rain falls mainly in one season, so dry-season farming depends on irrigation. Our fields use two types of sprinkler irrigation.

irri.pivot.text.zh: 多跨喷灌机以中心点为轴缓慢旋转，一台设备即可均匀覆盖一大片圆形农田，适合大面积连片种植的小麦。
irri.pivot.text.en: A multi-span machine slowly rotates around a central point, evenly watering a large circular field, which suits our broad wheat fields.

irri.reel.text.zh: 软管收卷时带动喷头车在田里移动，逐条完成灌溉；设备可以在不同地块之间转移，用于补充灌溉，也可对外租赁。
irri.reel.text.en: As the hose winds back onto the reel, it draws the sprinkler cart across the field strip by strip. It moves easily between fields for supplementary irrigation and is also available for hire.

crops.intro.zh: 这两种作物是我们农场的主力。
crops.intro.en: These two crops are the mainstay of our farms.

crops.wheat.text.zh: 在灌溉条件下种植，籽粒饱满，适合制粉和食品加工。马拉维所需的小麦绝大部分依赖进口，本地种植的小麦有助于减少这种依赖。
crops.wheat.text.en: Grown under irrigation for well-filled grain, suited to milling and food processing. Malawi imports almost all of its wheat, so locally grown wheat helps reduce that dependence.

crops.seed.text.zh: 按种子生产的要求种植和管理：隔离种植、及时去雄、田间去杂，单收单储，保证种子的纯度和质量。
crops.seed.text.en: Grown and managed to seed-production standards (isolated fields, timely detasselling, roguing of off-types, and separate harvest and storage) to protect seed purity and quality.
crops.seed.text.note: technical seed-production terms: detasselling, roguing (removing off-type plants)

hire.h2.en: Professional farm machinery, when you need it

hire.lead.zh: 从整地、播种、植保到收获和灌溉，我们自有的成套农业机械也对外出租。设备保养良好，可安排有经验的机手随机作业，帮助农场、庄园和合作社按时完成农活。
hire.lead.en: From land preparation and planting to spraying, harvesting and irrigation, our own fleet of farm machinery is available for hire. The equipment is well maintained and can come with an experienced operator, helping farms, estates and cooperatives get the work done on time.

hire.p2.zh: 在马拉维，用锄头人工整理一公顷土地需要 23–31 个工日，机械整地（含起垄）每公顷只需约 2–2.5 小时。整地晚两周，玉米产量最多可能减少 30%。提前预约，播种雨一到就能下种。
hire.p2.en: In Malawi, preparing one hectare by hand hoe takes 23–31 person-days; with machinery, including ridging, it takes about 2–2.5 hours. A two-week delay in land preparation can cut maize yields by up to 30%. Book early, and your land will be ready when the planting rains arrive.

hire.source.zh: 数据来源：马拉维科技大学 / MwAPATA 研究所；马拉维国家计划委员会与联合国开发计划署政策简报（2022）。
hire.source.en: Sources: Malawi University of Science and Technology / MwAPATA Institute; Malawi National Planning Commission & UNDP policy brief (2022).

hire.caption.zh: 圆盘犁在田间作业，后方是播种机等其他机械
hire.caption.en: A disc plough at work, with a seed drill and other machines behind

svc.prep.text.zh: 圆盘犁翻耕，深松机打破压实的犁底层。
svc.prep.text.en: Disc ploughing, plus subsoiling to break up compacted layers.

svc.plant.text.zh: 多行精量播种机，株距均匀、行距一致。
svc.plant.text.en: Multi-row precision planting for even seed spacing.

svc.spray.text.zh: 悬挂式喷杆喷雾机，用于大田除草和病虫害防治。
svc.spray.text.en: Tractor-mounted boom sprayers for weed, pest and disease control.

svc.harvest.text.zh: 自走式联合收割机，一次完成收割和脱粒。
svc.harvest.text.en: A self-propelled combine that harvests and threshes in one pass.

svc.irri.text.zh: 卷盘式喷灌机，可在地块之间转移，进行补充灌溉。
svc.irri.text.en: A hose-reel irrigator that moves between fields for supplementary watering.

svc.earth.text.zh: 履带式挖掘机，用于开沟、清障和农田基础工程。
svc.earth.text.en: A crawler excavator for ditches, clearing and farm infrastructure work.

fleet.lovol.text.zh: 220 马力级四驱驾驶室拖拉机，适合牵引圆盘犁、深松机和大型播种机。
fleet.lovol.text.en: A 220 hp-class 4WD cab tractor for pulling disc ploughs, subsoilers and large planters.

fleet.tk.text.zh: 带遮阳顶棚的多用途拖拉机，适合播种、喷药、轻型耕作和田间运输。
fleet.tk.text.en: A versatile canopy tractor for planting, spraying, lighter tillage and farm transport.

fleet.plough.text.zh: 七片圆盘的重型犁，用于硬地、干地和多秸秆地块的翻耕。
fleet.plough.text.en: A heavy seven-disc plough for primary tillage in hard, dry or trashy ground.

fleet.sub.text.zh: 打破耕层下压实的犁底层，改善渗水和根系生长。
fleet.sub.text.en: Breaks up compacted layers below plough depth, improving water infiltration and root growth.

fleet.planter.text.zh: 多行精量播种机，每个播种单体配独立种箱，适合玉米、大豆等中耕作物。
fleet.planter.text.en: A multi-row precision planter with a seed hopper on every row unit, for row crops such as maize and soybean.

fleet.sprayer.text.zh: 液压折叠喷杆，用于喷施除草剂、杀虫剂和叶面肥。
fleet.sprayer.text.en: Hydraulically folding booms for herbicide, pesticide and foliar-feed application.

fleet.combine.text.zh: 自走式谷物联合收割机，图中为玉米割台；可收获的作物和割台配置请咨询。
fleet.combine.text.en: A self-propelled grain combine, shown with a maize header. Ask us about crops and header options.

fleet.reel.text.zh: 移动式喷灌设备，适合小麦、玉米、蔬菜和牧草的补充灌溉。
fleet.reel.text.en: A travelling sprinkler for supplementary irrigation of wheat, maize, vegetables and pasture.

fleet.exc.text.zh: 用于开挖灌溉沟渠、清理障碍、修建农场道路等土方工程。
fleet.exc.text.en: For digging irrigation channels, clearing obstacles, building farm roads and other earthworks.

hstep1.text.en: The operation, field location, area and preferred dates.

hstep2.text.zh: 我们推荐合适的机型，确认排期，并给出报价。
hstep2.text.en: We recommend the right machines, confirm the schedule and send a quote.

hstep3.text.zh: 按约定时间进场，可配机手完成作业。
hstep3.text.en: We arrive on the agreed date, with an operator if needed.

hstep4.text.zh: 作业完成后与您一起验收。
hstep4.text.en: We check the finished work together with you.

hire.terms.zh: 租期、计费方式（按面积或按天）、是否含燃油和运输、是否配机手，均可按需求商定，以报价为准。
hire.terms.en: Hire period, charging basis (per hectare/acre or per day), fuel and transport, and operator arrangements are agreed case by case and confirmed in our quote.

band.text.zh: 整地和播种时节农机最紧张。告诉我们您的作业需求，我们会尽快确认排期。
band.text.en: Machinery is busiest at land-preparation and planting time. Tell us what you need and we'll confirm a slot as soon as possible.

process.h2.zh: 每一袋粮食和种子的来路
process.h2.en: Where every bag of grain and seed comes from

pstep1.text.zh: 整地播种，喷灌、施肥与植保全程管理。
pstep1.text.en: Land preparation and planting, then irrigation, nutrition and crop protection.

pstep2.text.zh: 作物成熟后适时收获；制种玉米单收单储。
pstep2.text.en: Harvested at maturity; seed maize is harvested and stored separately.

pstep3.text.zh: 清除杂质，按规格称重装袋。
pstep3.text.en: Impurities removed, then weighed and bagged to specification.

pstep4.text.zh: 入库保存，出库前逐批检验。
pstep4.text.en: Stored, then checked lot by lot before dispatch.

pstep5.text.zh: 按约定的规格、数量和时间交付。
pstep5.text.en: Delivered to the agreed specification, volume and date.

supply.text.zh: 我们直接向企业客户供应自产的小麦，并为种子企业生产制种玉米，按客户要求的规格交付。我们也开展其他农产品贸易，欢迎询价。
supply.text.en: We supply our own wheat directly to business customers and grow seed maize for seed companies, delivered to each customer's specification. We also trade other agricultural products; ask us for a quote.

why.h2.en: Farming, machinery and supply under one roof

why1.text.zh: 粮食和种子出自我们自己经营的农场，来源清楚。
why1.text.en: Our grain and seed come from farms we run ourselves, so the origin is never in doubt.

why2.text.zh: 中心支轴式和卷盘式喷灌按需供水，旱季也能稳定生产。
why2.text.en: Centre-pivot and hose-reel irrigation deliver water when crops need it, keeping production steady through the dry season.

why3.text.zh: 从整地到收获的成套机械，自用也对外租赁。
why3.text.en: A full set of machines from land preparation to harvest, used on our farms and available for hire.

why4.text.zh: 产品按约定的规格、数量和时间交付，农机按约定日期进场。
why4.text.en: Products delivered to the agreed spec, volume and date; machinery on site when promised.

about.h2.en: Rooted in Malawi, built to last

about.p.zh: Sycamore Agritech Limited 总部位于马拉维首都利隆圭，业务涵盖规模化种植、农业机械租赁和粮食供应。Sycamore（梧桐）是一种根深叶茂的树，我们以此为名，希望像它一样扎根土地、稳健生长，与客户建立长期合作。
about.p.en: Sycamore Agritech Limited is based in Lilongwe, Malawi's capital, and works across large-scale farming, agricultural machinery hire and grain supply. The sycamore is a broad, deep-rooted tree, and we chose its name because that is how we want to grow: rooted in the land, steady, and in long-term partnership with our customers.

about.quote.en: “Plant a sycamore, and the phoenix will come.”
about.quote.note: Chinese proverb; fr use « », pt use « »

about.quoteFoot.zh: 做好扎实的事，好的伙伴自然会来。
about.quoteFoot.en: An old Chinese saying: build something worthwhile, and good partners will follow.
